description: Source code implementing server-side SRP (Secure Remote Password) protocol functions, including server initialization, key generation, key exchange, verification, and cleanup.

methods.name: t_serveropenraw
methods.description: Initializes server state with user credentials and cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: t_servergenexp
methods.description: Generates server's ephemeral public value B based on private b and other parameters.

methods.name: t_servergetkey
methods.description: Computes session key based on client value and server's secret, performing SRP calculations.

methods.name: t_serververify
methods.description: Verifies client's response to authenticate session, producing session response.

methods.name: t_serverclose
methods.description: Cleans up server state and securely erases sensitive data.
